Subcontracting Opportunity

RFI 243824 Safety and Compliance Training Courses Provider

Business Name: Pacific Gas and Electric Company
Division/department: Professional Services
Website: https://www.pge.com/en/about/doing-business-with-pge/purchase programs/bid-oppo…
Opportunity name/identifier: RFI 243824 Safety and Compliance Training Courses Provider
Place of Performance: California
Performance Start Date: 10/15/2027
Closing Date: 11/4/2026

Description

PG&E is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to identify qualified training providers capable of delivering safety and compliance training throughout PG&E's service territory. The purpose of this RFI is to better understand the capabilities, geographic coverage, instructional capacity, and service offerings of organizations that can support PG&E's ongoing workforce development and compliance training needs.

Register interest no later than October 14th, 12:00 PM PT
RFI tentative release date: October 14, 2026.
Formal RFI responses are due November 4, 2026, 12pm PT

Please email Shannon Tyler-Zabel - https://www.poweradvocate.com/pR.do?okey=243824&pubEvent=true

Type of Businesses Being Solicited

  • Small Business (SB)
  • SAM.gov designated Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB)
  • SBA certified Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB)
  • SBA certified HUBZone Small Business (HUBZone SB)
  • SBA certified Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB)
  • SBA certified Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB)
  • Alaskan Native Corporation (ANC) or Indian Tribe (IT)
  • Native Hawaiian Organization (NHO)
  • Certified Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) – Dept of Transportation
  • Disadvantaged Veteran Business Enterprise (DVBE) – State of California
  • Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) – NMSDC certification (non-federal)
  • Woman Business Enterprise (WBE) – WBENC certification (non-federal)

NAICS code

  • 611430: Professional and Management Development Training

Point of Contact

Name: Shannon Tyler-Zabel
